data.description: All Call Back Service jobs must be scheduled as the final stop on a technician's route.

executable_logic.name: Call Back Service Last Stop
executable_logic.rule: All Call Back Service jobs must be scheduled as the final stop on a technician's route.
executable_logic.summary: This rule ensures that any Call Back Service job is automatically assigned as the last stop on a technician's daily route, allowing for flexible end-of-day scheduling and minimizing disruption to regular service schedules.
